title: Panda wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- panda face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='27' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='30' r='10' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='30' r='10' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='30' r='5' fill='#6a6a92'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='30' r='5' fill='#6a6a92'/>

  <ellipse cx='37' cy='50' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='50' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='24' y='43' width='23' height='15' rx='5' fill='#1b1b2e'/>
  <rect x='53' y='43' width='23' height='15' rx='5' fill='#1b1b2e'/>
  <rect x='45' y='48' width='10' height='4' fill='#1b1b2e'/>

  <rect x='53' y='43' width='23' height='15' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#8a8ab8' stroke-width='2'/>

  <path d='M29 46 L33 46 L29 53 Z' fill='#c9c9e8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M58 46 L62 46 L58 53 Z' fill='#c9c9e8' opacity='0.8'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#3a3a58'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62.5' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#6a6a92'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 68 Q50 73 44 74' fill='none' stroke='#5a5a80' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 68 Q50 73 56 74' fill='none' stroke='#5a5a80' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='65' r='5' fill='#f0a0b8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='65' r='5' fill='#f0a0b8' opacity='0.7'/>
